name: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom
rationale: 10-mana 12/12 but the exile-from-hand mode is a free mana rock that later casts her; slow decks love it, aggro can't use it. Mythic bomb-when-it-lands, often stranded.

name: Academic Ascent
rationale: 2-mana combat trick +2/+2 flying plus Empower 2 (a surveil + partial draw later). Tricks at common sit around 53-54; the Jace rider is a small plus.

name: Blossom-Blessed Angel // Seed Suture
rationale: 4-mana 2/4 flying vigilance that comes with a 1-mana +1/+1 counter spell: a solid 2-for-1 common body, GW counters payoff.

name: Campus Crier
rationale: 2-mana 3/1 with graveyard Empower 2; aggressive early but dies to everything; late game it still generates a surveil/draw.

name: Enlightened Confidant
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 lifelink that returns a milled card every turn it connects; mythic 2-drop with real card advantage in lifegain decks, fragile body limits it.

name: Fateshaper Aspirant
rationale: 5-mana 3/4 with a modest ETB (counter + protection, or regrow a legend). Filler-plus; many legends in this set make mode 1 live.

name: Flickering Hound
rationale: 4-mana 2/2 blink engine; blink re-prepares creatures and re-triggers ETBs (Oculus, Rank Rat), but the body is weak and it needs a creature-heavy build.

name: Generous Revival
rationale: 3-mana reanimate a 3-drop with a counter, with flashback: two bodies over a game. Depends on having fodder; decent in grindy decks.

name: Germinate Recruits
rationale: Instant X 2/2s equal to life gained this turn: needs setup to be more than a 3-mana 2/2 or two. Build-around rare, often clunky.

name: Graft Surgeon
rationale: 3-mana 3/3 that passes its counters on death: fine Vigorbloom common filler.

name: Guiding Hydra
rationale: X-drop that converts counters into team anthems every combat; flexible curve filler early, team-wide pump late. Strong rare.

name: Hexhaven Battalion
rationale: 6 mana for three 2/2s plus Empower 2, with landcycling 2 - never dead, big late-game swing; landcyclers at common averaged ~55.7 and this is one of the better payoffs.

name: Kindred Judgment
rationale: 7-mana one-sided-ish wrath (choose your own creature type); very slow but a game-winner for controlling decks.

name: Loyal Tutor
rationale: 1-mana tutor that only finds planeswalkers to the top of the library: card disadvantage in almost every limited deck.

name: Memory Trap
rationale: 3-mana O-ring at common hitting any nonland permanent; O-ring commons averaged ~58.5 historically, a bit of enchantment-removal exposure here (Budding Insurgent).

name: Predictive Preparations
rationale: 2 mana: two +1/+1 counters split over two creatures, flashback for 4. Sorcery-speed but strong in GW counters; comparable commons sit ~55-56.

name: Prophesied End
rationale: 2-mana instant unconditional kill, but the opponent draws a card unless the creature was attacking. Harsh Annotation-type drawbacks cost a lot (50.9) but drawing is milder and instants on attackers avoid it.

name: Refute Destiny
rationale: Sorcery exile of a green or blue creature/planeswalker plus surveil 1. Color-hoser removal: ~40% of opposing creatures are hit.

name: Repurposed Enforcer
rationale: 2-mana 3/2 that empowers Jace by your creature count on attack: 2-drop aggression that generates card draw. Strong in go-wide decks.

name: Return to the Light Realms
rationale: 9-mana mass reanimation; rarely castable, mythic that is a near-blank in most games.

name: Shatterwing Pegasus
rationale: 3-mana 2/3 flier with a late-game team pump; solid evasive common body.

name: Surgical Precision
rationale: Modal: kill toughness>=4 or draw a card + gain 2. Never dead, cheap; the big-butt kill matters in a set with many 3/4 and 4/4 bodies.

name: Unflinching Hortimancer
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 ward 1 that grows with lifegain; good in GW lifegain, fragile otherwise.

name: Your Fate Ends Here
rationale: 3-mana instant destroy MV>=3 creature/planeswalker + surveil 1. Hits most relevant threats; premium uncommon removal.

name: Countersculpt
rationale: Hard counter for UU+1 (or UU with a Jace) that also empowers Jace 1. Counterspells averaged ~56.4 historically; this is efficient.

name: Cruel Calculations
rationale: 3-mana draw X where X = cards milled from their library this turn: needs self-mill set-up (Omit Variables, Primal Witchstalker). Explosive in Theorix, otherwise dead.

name: Cryotheory Adept
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 prowess with a late-game graveyard stun effect; decent filler with a non-dead late mode.

name: Diviner of Victory // Unwind History
rationale: 1-mana 1/1 that grows on scry/surveil and carries a 2-mana tempo bounce + surveil. Low impact body, good in WU scry decks.

name: Divining Duelist
rationale: 3-mana 3/2 flash with tap/untap/loot; flexible tempo common.

name: Icy Reception
rationale: Modal soft counter (unless pay 3) or -5/-0; situational common, playable 23rd card.

name: Infinite Coursework
rationale: 3-mana aura: taps, strips abilities and freezes the creature (also unprepares it). Aura removal in these formats ran 58-59 (Frozen in Ice, Sleep Magic); slightly worse vs. enchantment removal.

name: Jace's Machinations
rationale: Instant Empower 8 (immediate draw, another draw next turn, then surveils) + a loyalty body that soaks attacks; 3-mana card advantage, better with Sanctum Lurker / Way enchantments.

name: Mindseeker Oculus
rationale: 3-mana 2/1 whose Empower 4 nets an immediate draw and a later surveil: cantrip body plus planeswalker enabler.

name: Perfected Theory
rationale: 1-mana modal trick (shrink to 1/1 or pump to 4/5); flexible but low raw power.

name: Plan for All Outcomes
rationale: 4-mana enchantment: top/bottom-of-library a nonland permanent (slow removal) + repeatable Empower 1. Clunky but a real 2-for-1 over time.

name: Precise Redaction
rationale: Counter target white or black spell: narrow 2-mana counter, often dead.

name: Protege's Awakening
rationale: 4 mana: draw a card + Empower 6 (draw now, draw next turn) - roughly draw 3 over two turns plus a chump-absorbing token. Quick Study was 56.4 in SOS.

name: Seasoned Cryomancer
rationale: 3-mana 2/2: draw 2 / discard 2 with stun counters for each nonland discard (tempo swing on up to two creatures), plus a late draw-2 from the graveyard. Mythic rate value.

name: Semester Foreseer // Peer Review
rationale: 4-mana 3/4 surveil 1 that comes prepared with a 3-mana Cadet + surveil: two bodies for one card, Fatehold payoff. Solid common.

name: Sphinx of False Conclusions
rationale: 4-mana 4/2 flash flier that loots on attack and returns as a token copy when it dies: evasive, resilient card advantage rare.

name: Sphinx's Approach
rationale: 1UU instant draw two; Quick Study was 56.4 in SOS. Rarely tutors a Sphinx.

name: Surveillance Phantasm
rationale: 2-mana 2/3 flying vigilance defender that attacks if you scried/surveiled; good blocker, needs the WU shell to attack.

name: The Theorist, Jace Beleren
rationale: 4-mana mythic walker: extra card every opponent's turn, +1 makes blockers, -2 bounces. Protects itself and buries opponents in cards.

name: Theorist's Proxy
rationale: 2-mana 0/3 flash with Empower 3 (immediate draw): a flash cantrip blocker that turns on planeswalker payoffs.

name: Undulating Witness
rationale: 5-mana 3/5 flier with landcycling 2; flexible common that is never dead, body is fine but not exciting.

name: Unsummon
rationale: 1-mana bounce; tempo card that pairs with ETB/prepare value. Typically 53-55 at common.

name: Variable Chaser // Arc of Fortune
rationale: 3-mana 2/3 flying prowess that comes prepared with a 3-mana symmetrical wheel; evasive body with a spell attached. Rare quality tempo.

name: Apex Witchstalker
rationale: 6-mana 6/4 menace with lifegain ETB/death and landcycling 2; top-end that is never dead.

name: Bloodline Recollector // Ancestral Craving
rationale: 2-mana 2/2 that only prepares when three creatures die in a turn; Ancestral Craving is powerful but rarely available. Mythic in name only in limited.

name: Break Under Pressure
rationale: 3-mana instant edict of the greatest-MV creature/planeswalker + 2 life; reliably hits their best threat.

name: Cast Away Doubt
rationale: 3-mana draw two + 2 damage to each player; Divination with a Stingerquill (noncombat damage) rider.

name: Dark Matter Manipulator
rationale: 1-mana 1/2 that mills 3 and grows +2/+0 per seven graveyard cards; a fine Theorix enabler that becomes a 3/2 or 5/2 later.

name: Darklight Phoenix
rationale: 4-mana 3/2 flying haste that recurs when two creatures die in a turn; evasive aggressive mythic with recursion in sacrifice/removal-heavy games.

name: Extended Absence
rationale: 4-mana instant exile creature/planeswalker with 1 damage + 1 life; 4-mana unconditional exile instants ran 56.3-57.0.

name: Extrapolate the Impossible
rationale: Wish effect - a 2-mana do-nothing in digital limited (no sideboard in Bo1).

name: Last Gasp
rationale: 2-mana -3/-3 instant; same card was 57.8 in SOS.

name: Lich's Relic
rationale: 1-mana equipment that, for 2 more, destroys a creature or planeswalker, then stays as +2/+1 equipment. Flexible premium removal plus a permanent.

name: Multiply by Zero
rationale: 2-mana instant 'base P/T 0/0' - kills anything without +1/+1 counters; weaker against the GW counters deck but premium otherwise.

name: Overwrite the Multiverse
rationale: 6-mana exile all creatures plus Empower X (often drawing 2-3 cards). Wraths in limited are swingy but this one refills your hand; mythic rate.

name: Rampart Hunter
rationale: 4-mana 3/3 deathtouch with an ETB pump/deathtouch grant that often acts as removal in combat; solid common.

name: Rank Rat
rationale: 2-mana 1/1 that makes each opponent discard: 2-mana discard ETB 1/1s ran 55.8-57.0; body here is weak in a format with Cadets.

name: Rewrite Regrets
rationale: 4-mana reanimate MV<=6 creature/planeswalker + Empower 2: decent value if you have targets; sometimes dead early.

name: Rise of the Deathbringer
rationale: 5-mana instant: draw cards equal to your greatest power, or -3/-3 sweep; both modes are strong and the card is never dead.

name: Sanctum Lurker
rationale: 3-mana 3/2 that keeps 0-loyalty Jace tokens alive and gives every planeswalker a +2 drain; turns every Empower card into a permanent engine. Strong in this set.

name: Screeching Soulbreaker
rationale: 3-mana 1/4 flier that pings on attack; Stingerquill enabler, slow clock.

name: Silence the Echo
rationale: 2-mana sorcery destroy creature/planeswalker if you sacrifice or pay 3 more; 5-mana unconditional removal with an occasional discount. Similar cards ran 56.2-57.0.

name: Solve for Disappointment
rationale: 2-mana targeted discard of a nonland permanent + Empower 1; card parity with slight tempo loss, better in long games.

name: Terminal Criticism
rationale: 2-mana instant destroy blue or red creature/planeswalker + 1 life; color hoser with roughly 40% coverage.

name: Theoretical Necromancer
rationale: 3-mana 4/1 with a graveyard Raise Dead ability; trades down too easily but gives late value.

name: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables
rationale: 2-mana 2/2 with threshold +1/+1 and a 1-mana mill 3 attached; enables Theorix but low raw power.

name: Vraska's Final Mercy
rationale: BB sorcery: pay 2 life, destroy a creature or planeswalker (or Empower 6). 2-mana unconditional removal at rare.

name: Ajani's Anguish
rationale: X-damage to any target (scalable removal/reach) plus a permanent team trample enchantment. Flexible rare removal.

name: Artifist Acumen
rationale: 1-mana cantrip team first strike; low impact filler.

name: Awaken the Inferno
rationale: 5-mana 6 damage to a creature/planeswalker plus a +1/+1 counter, with landcycling 2. 5-mana 6-damage commons ran 54-57.6 and landcycling removes the dead-draw problem.

name: Blazing Crescendo
rationale: Same card was 52.9 in MSH; +3/+1 trick with impulse draw.

name: Chandra's Emberling
rationale: 3-mana 2/2 haste that grows with noncreature spells; filler for spells decks.

name: Command the Stage
rationale: 3-mana Cadet-maker with a Wizard-token anthem effect that recurs if you dealt noncombat damage last turn; repeatable in Stingerquill, slow elsewhere.

name: Craterclaw Colossus
rationale: 7-mana 5/5 haste with an artifact-count team pump; big finisher but expensive, needs RG artifact support.

name: Curse-Marred Demon
rationale: 4-mana 4/4 flying trample that tutors any card (random discard). Rare evasive beater with card selection: top-tier rare.

name: Draconic Visitor
rationale: 5-mana 5/5 flier; with Heartwood/Thopter/Lotus makers every artifact token becomes a 5/5 Dragon. 5-cmc 5/5 fliers ran ~61 even without the upside.

name: Eardrum Rattler
rationale: 2-mana 2/2 that makes a small creature unblockable; marginal common.

name: Essence Burn
rationale: 2-mana 5 damage to a black or green creature/planeswalker (exile); color-hoser removal.

name: Face Yourself
rationale: 7-mana copy a player's whole board with haste; swingy mythic-style finisher that often arrives too late; needs a planeswalker to keep the copies.

name: Fulminous Forte
rationale: 3-mana instant: 5 damage to a creature/planeswalker or 1 damage to each enemy creature/walker (eats Cadets, Thopters, 1/1s). Premium flexible removal.

name: Hallway Heckler // Vicious Verse
rationale: 3-mana 2/3 rummager that comes prepared with a 1-mana ping; Stingerquill enabler, modest stats.

name: Heartstring Puller
rationale: 4-mana 3/1 trample + a 2/2 Cadet: two bodies for one card, fragile but fine.

name: Identity Echo
rationale: Repeatable polymorph for 4 each activation; random and expensive, build-around rare.

name: Master of Barbs
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 menace with a Stingerquill team-pump trigger; aggressive rare 2-drop.

name: No Admittance
rationale: 2-mana sorcery 3 damage to any target + Empower 1; 2-mana 3-damage commons ran 55.5-57.5 and the Jace rider is a plus.

name: Pompous Battlemage // Improvised Act
rationale: 1-mana 1/1 prowess with a 1-mana rummage attached; low impact rare.

name: Pyre Rhymer // Molten Tide
rationale: 3-mana 3/3 prowess with a ritual-like spell attached: good rate body, spell side rarely matters.

name: Skilled Battlecarver
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 with first strike on your turn and firebreathing; aggressive filler.

name: Stingcaster Mage
rationale: 2-mana 2/1 haste that gives a graveyard instant/sorcery flashback - re-buy removal; mythic 2-drop with real card advantage mid-game.

name: Tether Technician
rationale: 5-mana 4/5 reach with an optional discard-for-2-damage ETB (finishes small creatures, triggers Stingerquill). Good common top-end.

name: Violent Echoes
rationale: 4-mana instant 6 damage to a creature/planeswalker with excess converting to Empower (cards). Premium uncommon removal.

name: Wrath of the Bloodmane
rationale: 3-mana (2 with a legend) instant 4 damage to a creature/planeswalker; many legends in this set make the discount frequent.

name: Arcane Amphisbaena
rationale: 2-mana 1/1 deathtouch with Empower 2 (surveil + partial draw later); good early blocker with a planeswalker rider.

name: Bestial Incursion
rationale: 4 mana for a 4/4 trample token with flashback 6: two 4/4s from one card; comparable commons ran ~56-57.

name: Budding Insurgent
rationale: 3-mana 3/3 vigilance that can sacrifice to kill an artifact/enchantment (drawing a card off legendary enchantments such as the Way cycle). Solid body with a relevant late mode.

name: Carnivorous Cultivator // Enroot
rationale: 2-mana 2/3 deathtouch (excellent blocker) that comes prepared with a land-to-graveyard tutor it can later regrow. Rare rate body.

name: Compel Brutality
rationale: 2-mana instant bite (also from planeswalker loyalty); green's best common removal, pairs with big bodies and Jace tokens.

name: Flourishing Grapple
rationale: 1-mana bite against red or white permanents only; color-hoser removal with the lowest reliability of the cycle.

name: Gardenize
rationale: 3-mana enchantment that ramps only when your creatures die; near-blank build-around rare.

name: Greenhouse Propagator
rationale: 3-mana 2/3 mana dork with incidental lifegain; ramp filler for Vigorbloom.

name: Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether
rationale: 1-mana 1/1 'colorless mana for abilities' plus a 3-mana Heartwood token spell; slow Konstrari enabler, low impact.

name: Hexhaven Invigorator
rationale: GGGG 6/6 vigilance that ramps when damaged; heavy color requirement but a huge 4-drop body in mono/heavy green.

name: Hungering Puppetbeast
rationale: 5-mana 5/5 artifact creature that makes a Heartwood token and can eat artifacts for counters/trample/hexproof/haste. Strong rare top-end.

name: Hunter's Axe
rationale: 1-mana equipment +2/+0 with trample/deathtouch on attack, equip 2; cheap repeatable damage boost, fine in aggro.

name: Inspired Tethermage
rationale: 3-mana 3/2 that grows whenever you empower Jace; needs the Jace shell, has a 6-mana sink.

name: Omnipresence
rationale: 8-mana enchantment that only cheats spells if you already have a wide board; almost never castable in time.

name: Puppet Crafting
rationale: 2-mana aura turning an artifact/enchantment into a 5/5 construct, recurs from graveyard; needs Heartwood/Books/Way enchantments to be a 5/5 for 2.

name: Restore with Empathy
rationale: 3-mana instant regrowth of any permanent card + 4 life; grindy value, card neutral.

name: Simulacrum Shaper
rationale: 3-mana 2/2 that ramps a basic land and draws on death: card-advantage ramp body at rare.

name: Something Worth Saving
rationale: 2-mana mill 4 + take a permanent + 1 life; Theorix enabler with card parity.

name: Sureshot Sower
rationale: 2-mana 3/1 reach that can be discarded to destroy a flier; flexible common 2-drop.

name: Tarmogoyf
rationale: 2-mana creature that is routinely 3/4-4/5 by turn 4 in a set with self-mill, artifacts and planeswalker tokens; cheap, big mythic body.

name: Tethermage's Advantage
rationale: 1-mana +2/+2 reach + untap trick; standard trick level.

name: Verdant Kraken
rationale: 7-mana 6/6 that makes a 3/3 land creature every upkeep (both players' turns); expensive but overwhelming top-end rare.

name: Vinelasher Adept
rationale: 6-mana 2/4 reach that puts three +1/+1 counters on a creature, landcycling 2; flexible common, late-game 5/7 of stats.

name: Wrecking Gecko
rationale: 5-mana 5/5 ward 2 artifact creature with a late pump; sturdy common top-end that fuels Konstrari artifact counts.

name: Aerid Konstrari
rationale: 4-mana 5/4 flier that makes a Heartwood on ETB and death: huge rate evasive mythic that also ramps.

name: Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes
rationale: 2-mana 2/3 that empowers Jace 2 on every land drop: a 2-drop that draws a card every other turn; mythic engine.

name: Blessed Ghoul
rationale: 1-mana hybrid 1/1 lifelink that recurs for 3; sacrifice fodder for WB, low impact.

name: Bloombrute
rationale: 4-mana 4/4 that draws a card on your first lifegain each turn; GW payoff with a strong body.

name: Charge the Sanctum
rationale: 3-mana hybrid modal pump (team +2/+0 or +2/+0 first strike + counter); hybrid trick, below average.

name: Clash of Elements
rationale: 3-mana instant pseudo-removal (nonland permanent to top of library with 2 damage, or to bottom); strong tempo/removal for UR.

name: Craftwork Crusher
rationale: 7-mana 7/5 trample with two of: 4 damage, a Cadet, draw a card. Expensive but a 3-for-1; gold uncommon finisher.

name: Denzilore Fatehold
rationale: 4-mana 3/4 flash flier that pumps your team on every scry/surveil; snowballing mythic in the WU shell.

name: Desperate Futurescribe
rationale: 4-mana 3/4 flier that grants +1/+1 (or a counter with scry/surveil) each combat; evasive gold uncommon with incremental value.

name: Emergency Phytomedic // Seed Suture
rationale: 1-mana hybrid 1/1 that comes prepared with a 1-mana counter spell; two cheap effects but tiny bodies.

name: Entrust the Spark
rationale: 5-mana sorcery that needs a planeswalker to sacrifice and another in the deck; near-blank in limited.

name: Fatehold Charm
rationale: 2-mana modal: draw + Empower 2 / bounce spell or creature / team +1/+2. Flexible gold charm, charms ran 54-60.

name: Fatehold Chronologist // Peer Review
rationale: 2-mana hybrid 1/2 flier that comes prepared with a 3-mana Cadet + surveil; two bodies, weak stats.

name: Ferocity of the Hunt
rationale: 2-mana flash aura +1/+0 deathtouch that returns the creature when it dies; combat-trick-ish aura with resilience; hybrid common.

name: Frostbite Pyromental
rationale: 3-mana 4/4 trample haste that draws 2 on connecting but dies at end of turn; Ball Lightning with a card draw - great on an empty board, otherwise a burn spell.

name: Grim Repriser
rationale: 2-mana 2/2 prowess that recurs for BR after noncombat damage; sticky Stingerquill 2-drop.

name: Ingris Stingerquill
rationale: 3-mana 1/4 flier that makes every attacker ping; a Cadet-making mana sink giving haste. Mythic engine that closes games fast.

name: Konstrari Charm
rationale: 2-mana modal: 6 damage to a flier / two counters + trample / add CCC. Situational removal plus pump; mid-tier charm.

name: Konstrari Improviser // Soul Tether
rationale: 2-mana hybrid 2/2 that comes prepared with a 3-mana Heartwood spell; body plus ramp, modest.

name: Kwia Vigorbloom
rationale: 6-mana 6/6 flying vigilance lifelink ward 2 that makes Lotus tokens on lifegain; near-unbeatable mythic finisher.

name: Mind Meanderer
rationale: 6-mana 4/4 flier that fights on ETB (removal + body), vigilance with a Jace; gold uncommon top-end 2-for-1.

name: Null Summoner
rationale: 4-mana 4/2 that exiles the best nonland card from their hand and can later cast it with threshold; strong tempo + card advantage rare.

name: Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables
rationale: 2-mana hybrid 1/3 that re-prepares every upkeep to mill 3 each turn; repeatable Theorix enabler with graveyard manipulation.

name: Primal Witchstalker
rationale: 3-mana 2/1 menace that mills 4 and returns a land tapped: card-neutral self-mill ramp for BG.

name: Proctor of Potential
rationale: 2-mana 3/1 that surveils on every creature ETB and recurs for WU with scry/surveil; aggressive, sticky, selection-generating rare.

name: Prudent Fateseer // Peer Review
rationale: 3-mana 1/4 that pumps the team on scry/surveil and comes prepared with a Cadet + surveil spell; two bodies plus a WU payoff.

name: Recursive Recruitment
rationale: 4 mana for two 2/2 Cadets, flashback for 8 with +1/+1 counters per three graveyard cards; two casts give four bodies, grindy uncommon.

name: Solarium Sentry
rationale: 2-mana 3/3 that gains 2 life whenever the opponent casts a cheap spell: over-statted rare 2-drop with constant Vigorbloom triggers.

name: Solitary Cell
rationale: 2-mana O-ring for MV<=3 nonland permanents with a card-draw outlet for legends; cheap removal on a permanent, rare.

name: Stingerquill Charm
rationale: 2-mana modal: 3 damage to any target / first strike + deathtouch / hasty Cadet. Removal-first charm; charms ran 54-60.

name: Stingerquill Voxmancer // Vicious Verse
rationale: 1-mana hybrid 1/2 that re-prepares every upkeep to ping each turn for 1; slow but repeatable Stingerquill enabler.

name: Stinging Vitriol
rationale: 2-mana sorcery: 2 damage to the opponent + targeted discard; card parity with Stingerquill triggers.

name: Tam's Resistance
rationale: 2-mana hybrid: +1/+1 counter + vigilance + Empower 4 (immediate draw). Cheap cantrip buff that creates a planeswalker.

name: Tenured Tethermage
rationale: 3-mana 1/1 that sacrifices a land for two Heartwoods (net +1 mana) and grows by tapping artifacts; ramp + mana-sink body at rare.

name: Theorix Charm
rationale: 2-mana modal: soft counter noncreature / -2/-2 / mill 3 + draw. Flexible gold charm with removal mode.

name: Theorix Metamage // Omit Variables
rationale: 3-mana hybrid 2/3 that gains flying and +1/+0 with threshold and comes prepared with a 1-mana mill 3; self-enabling evasive body.

name: Twinned Vision
rationale: 2-mana hybrid cantrip that draws 2 when flashed back for 3 + discard; card-flow filler for UR spells.

name: Twisted Fates
rationale: 5-mana sorcery Vindicate (destroy any nonland permanent) plus a +1/+1 counter on each of your creatures; expensive but a big swing.

name: Uldaros Theorix
rationale: 6-mana 5/5 flier that recasts copies of your best graveyard spells for free (total MV<=6); mythic evasive finisher with built-in 2-for-1+.

name: Vigorbloom Charm
rationale: 2-mana modal: protection / draw + 3 life / counter + fight (removal). Removal-mode charm with card draw backup.

name: Vigorbloom Vanguard // Seed Suture
rationale: 2-mana hybrid 2/2 that comes prepared with a counter spell and gives countered creatures vigilance; two cheap effects.

name: Vindictive Triumph
rationale: 3-mana instant exile creature/planeswalker that also threatens a cheap creature for a turn; premium rare removal.

name: Warrior's Blades
rationale: 4-mana equipment: 3 damage to any target + 3 life on ETB, then +2/+1 with a cheaper equip on countered creatures. Removal plus permanent value.

name: Whiplash Wordsmith // Vicious Verse
rationale: 4-mana hybrid 3/3 with conditional flying/haste and a 1-mana ping attached; self-enabling evasive body in BR.

name: Woodwork Prodigy // Soul Tether
rationale: 3-mana 3/3 that re-prepares every upkeep to make a Heartwood each turn; strong rate body plus repeatable ramp.

name: Afterthought Sentry
rationale: 2-mana 2/2 artifact with a flying tax and graveyard hate; colorless filler, better in Konstrari artifact decks.

name: Archive Arbiter
rationale: 6-mana 4/4 flier that destroys a noncreature nonland permanent or gains 4; colorless top-end playable in any deck.

name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
rationale: 3-mana 1/4 that copies prepared spells; defensive body with modest upside unless you have many prepare cards.

name: The Echoverse Fulcrum
rationale: 2-mana loot on ETB and a 5-mana one-shot wrath; a colorless Damnation-in-a-can for controlling decks, slow.

name: Eye of Jace
rationale: 1-mana upkeep surveil that eventually sacrifices for a 2-point drain; Theorix/Fatehold enabler with low board impact.

name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
rationale: 3-mana 3/2 artifact with Empower 2; colorless body plus a surveil/draw token for any deck.

name: Living Library
rationale: 2-mana 0/4 wall with a 6-mana shuffle-away removal; defensive filler.

name: Medic's Kitesail
rationale: 2-mana equipment granting flying, +1/+0 and lifegain on attack; equipment at common is usually below average, but evasion matters.

name: Murmuring Volume
